description: PLAYER REPORT (2026-08-27): 'I used the Leap to Defend stratagem, or attempted to, when it was my opponent's charge phase. It gave me the option. I clicked it, but then nothing happened. The charge phase continued without my unit even rolling a charge.' The counter-charge 2D6 IS rolled server-side the moment a mode is picked, but ChargePhase emits it with context 'heroic_intervention_charge_roll' and every UI consumer in ChargeController._on_dice_rolled filtered on context == 'charge_roll' — so the roll was never animated, never written to the dice log, and a roll that fell short (which ends the Charge phase on the spot, 1 CP already spent) produced no feedback whatsoever. This scenario parks the Witchseekers 11.5" edge-to-edge from the Warboss that charged this turn: inside LEAP TO DEFEND's 12" window, so the option is genuinely offered, but needing ~10.5" when the seeded 2D6 gives 8. It clicks the REAL Leap to Defend button and asserts the player is now told what happened — the roll and the shortfall both appear in the dice log — and separately that a mode with no legal target (INTO THE FRAY, with no enemy within 6") is rendered disabled instead of as a button that closes the window and does nothing.

steps.comment: P2 Orks are charging, so P1 Custodes is the defender offered the 15.11 window
the Warboss charged home this turn — that is what LEAP TO DEFEND reacts to
park the Witchseekers 11.5 inches edge-to-edge from the Warboss: inside LEAP's 12 inch window, but needing ~10.5 inches when the seeded 2D6 gives 8

steps.script:
var d = tree.current_scene._phase_end_confirm
if d != null and d.visible:
	d.get_ok_button().pressed.emit()
return true

steps.comment: LEAP TO DEFEND is live: a charged enemy sits 11.5 inches away, inside the 12 inch window

SECOND BUG: a row is offered when EITHER mode has a target, but both mode buttons were always enabled. Nothing is within 6 inches, so INTO THE FRAY can only be rejected — it must read as unavailable, not as a button that closes the window and does nothing.

steps.equals: No enemy is within 6" of this unit.
steps.comment: and it says why, rather than just going grey
baseline: nothing about a counter-charge roll in the Game Log yet
the reported click — the real button a player presses
and it reports the shortfall (11.5" apart, 2" engagement range), so the player can see the counter-charge was 1.5" short rather than guessing the click was ignored
baseline: nothing about a counter-charge roll in the Game Log yet

THE BUG: the counter-charge roll never reached the player. The Game Log now names the mode, the dice and the outcome — and it is the Game Log rather than the dice log because a failed HI ends the Charge phase immediately and the incoming phase's controller clears the shared dice log.
the 1 CP is gone whether or not the charge lands (15.11) — say so, since the phase ends immediately afterwards
unchanged rules behaviour: the stratagem was used (4 CP -> 3) and a failed Heroic Intervention still releases the Charge phase
and the Game Log PANEL renders it — the entry store alone would pass on a line the player never sees
the Game Log, not the Dice Log: the incoming phase clears the shared dice log, so this is where the outcome has to survive
